title: 왜, 외, 웨: 세 글자, 같은 소리
objective: Read syllables with ㅙ, ㅚ, or ㅞ as [we], and understand that you must memorize which spelling each word uses.
summary: ㅙ, ㅚ, and ㅞ are spelled differently, but they usually sound the same: [we].

task.title: Read, spell and say
task.line: Say each item out loud first, then write or choose your answer.

letters.sound: [wɛ]: ㅗ + ㅐ said fast, like 'we' in 'wet'
letters.as: Found in common native words: 왜, 돼지

letters.sound: Standard [ø]; [we] is also correct and most common
letters.as: Often in Chinese-origin words: 회사, 최고

letters.sound: [we]: ㅜ + ㅔ said fast, like 'we' in 'wet'
letters.as: Common in English loanwords: 스웨터, 웨이터

letters.sound: In daily speech all three sound the same: [we]
letters.as: Sound gives no hint, so learn each word's spelling

exercises: Write the vowel you see (ㅙ, ㅚ or ㅞ): ① 쇄 ② 궤 ③ 괴
Write each word in romanization: ① 교회 (church) ② 돼요 (OK, it works) ③ 외워요 (I memorize)
Say both syllables out loud. Do they sound the same or different? ① 왜 – 웨 ② 외 – 와 ③ 쇄 – 쉐
Choose the right spelling: ① a hair wave: 웨이브 / 왜이브 ② overseas: 해외 / 해웨
answers: ① ㅙ ② ㅞ ③ ㅚ
① gyohoe ② dwaeyo ③ oewoyo
① Same: both are [we] ② Different: in daily speech 외 is [we], but 와 is [wa] ③ Same: both are [쉐]
① 웨이브 (an English loanword, so it uses ㅞ) ② 해외
